name: Yotta NM1 (Panvel)
notes: Asia's largest Uptime Tier IV certified data centre (7,000-7,200 racks, ~50-52 MW power); first of five planned buildings at the Integrated Yotta Data Centre Park, Hiranandani Fortune City, Panvel (Raigad district, Navi Mumbai).

name: Yotta NM2 (Panvel)
notes: Second data centre building at Yotta park, Hiranandani Fortune City, Panvel; reported fully operational (52-65 MW) with advanced compute shell upgrades as of June 2026.

name: Yotta Navi Mumbai Data Centre Park expansion (NM3-NM5)
notes: Park master plan: five data centre buildings at the 18-acre Panvel site with 30,000 racks and ~210-250 MW total capacity (NM3-NM5 remaining phases); company has said the campus is scalable to ~1 GW.

name: AirTrunk Raigad Pen Growth Centre campus
notes: Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis announced on 1 Jun 2026 that a Letter of Intent for land allotment was exchanged with AirTrunk CEO Robin Khuda at the Raigad Pen Growth Centre (Orange City); ~Rs 2 lakh crore (~US$21-24bn) investment, planned 3 GW capacity; part of AirTrunk's US$30bn / 5 GW India commitment (entered India via Lumina CloudInfra acquisition, Apr 2026).

name: Microsoft Azure India Central region (Pune)
notes: Azure Central India region located in Pune (operational since ~2015; Microsoft announced Pune entry in Mar 2015). Facilities include Bhosari MIDC, Pimpri-Chinchwad area; new availability zones announced in 2024. Capacity not publicly disclosed.

name: STT GDC Pune campus (STT Pune 1-5, Hinjewadi)
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC)
notes: Five carrier-neutral facilities (STT Pune 1-5) in Hinjewadi IT corridor; Baxtel market data lists ~65.3 MW operational across the five sites.

name: Nxtra by Airtel Pune data centers (Pune I & II, Hinjewadi)
notes: Nxtra Pune II is the largest data centre in Pune at ~21 MW (Baxtel); Nxtra's Pune site lists 17 MW IT power / 4,000 racks; part of a planned ~250 MW hyperscale campus at Hinjewadi Phase III.

name: Nxtra Pune III (Hinjewadi)
notes: ~350,000 sq ft hyperscale facility under construction in Hinjewadi, ~40 MW, expected launch Q4 2026; part of Nxtra's Pune campus expansion (Fortune India reported a new up-to-150 MW hyperscale centre in Pune).

name: AdaniConneX Pune campus (Pimpri)
notes: Hyperscale campus in Pimpri industrial zone (Pune district); ~9.6 MW already operational with ~86 MW under construction (Q3 2026 target per Baxtel); follows Adani Group's ~US$6bn Maharashtra data centre commitment covering Mumbai/Navi Mumbai and Pune (MoU with Maharashtra govt, Jan 2024).

name: Iron Mountain / Web Werks Pune (PUN-1, Hinjewadi)
developer: Web Werks / Iron Mountain Data Centers
notes: 1.6 MW facility on a 1.2-acre Hinjewadi site (phased scaling to ~2 MW), ~18 km from Pune airport; one of the most interconnected DCs in Pune.

name: Tata Communications Pune (Tata Jade IDC)
notes: Carrier-grade data centre in Pune operated under Tata Communications' Jade IDC brand; capacity not publicly disclosed.

name: NES Data Pune
notes: 4 MW enterprise facility in Pune; parent TCC Concept plans to build 100 MW of data center capacity in the medium term, including a possible ~60 MW development in Pune.

name: NES Data Talegaon campus
notes: Large campus at Talegaon (Pune district) under construction/planned; ~10 MW first phase expected around Q4 2026 per Baxtel.

name: Silvernox Pune
notes: Small carrier-neutral data centre in Pune.

name: NICSI Pune
notes: Small government data centre operated by NICSI in Pune.
